title: DEVOPS↔SEC-001: Artifact Signing + Secrets Management
description: Security defines artifact-signing/key/PKI requirements, secrets-management requirements, hardening/compliance rules, and threat findings; DevOps implements signing infrastructure, secrets management (Vault), hardened infrastructure, RBAC, and image/dependency scanning to the baseline. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4 and SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.5.

signing_required.description: All release artifacts must be signed (security baseline).

key_id.description: Signing key identifier (reference only; key material never appears here).

key_storage.description: Where the signing key is held; raw keys are forbidden in repos/configs.

secret_refs.description: References only — never literal secret values.

rotation_days.description: Maximum secret rotation interval in days.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Security-baseline surface (signing, key storage, secrets) — ESC-SEC; SEC owns binding decisions and holds HG-01 release veto. Agents may only propose.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (baseline handoff at planning); implementation reviews; pre-production security sign-off
confirm_conditions: signing.signing_required = true with an approved algorithm and key_storage ∈ {VAULT, HSM, KMS}
secrets are Vault references only — no literal secret values anywhere in the artifact
image_scan_passed and dependency_scan_passed are true; open findings within the CVSS remediation SLA
reject_conditions: any literal secret/key material present (ESC-SEC — immediate)
signing disabled or a non-approved algorithm proposed
failed image/dependency scan with an open Critical past the 7-day SLA
counter_conditions: rotation_days exceeds policy — request a rotation-schedule correction
a new artifact type lacks a signing path — request SEC to extend the baseline (do not self-approve)
